title: Inverted Elevator Descent
description: A woman in a long red Victorian dress stands inside an ornate golden elevator hanging upside down from the ceiling of a flooded, decaying hallway. She holds a suitcase and reaches upward as the elevator doors open into the inverted space, while a crystal chandelier and numerous framed portraits of the same woman float above dark water filled with lily pads and film strips.
prompt: A surreal scene of an ornate golden elevator hanging upside down from a cracked ceiling in a decaying flooded hallway. A woman in a long red Victorian dress with floral details stands inside the open elevator, holding a vintage suitcase and reaching upward. A large crystal chandelier hangs below her. The dark water is covered in lily pads and floating film strips. The walls are lined with many identical framed portraits of the woman. Cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, highly detailed surreal painting.
